@@ -0,0 +1,149 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Prepares a fresh Amp orb (Debian 12): PHP 8.4 + Composer, Node 24, PostgreSQL 18,
+# project dependencies, .env files and Laravel Boost. Idempotent; reruns on stale snapshots.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
+cd "$repo_root"
+
+PHP_VERSION=8.4
+PG_VERSION=18
+NODE_MAJOR="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .nvmrc)"
+
+step() {
+  local name="$1"
+  shift
+  local start=$SECONDS
+  echo "==> ${name}"
+  "$@"
+  echo "<== ${name} ($((SECONDS - start))s)"
+}
+
+apt_packages=(
+  "php${PHP_VERSION}-cli" "php${PHP_VERSION}-bcmath" "php${PHP_VERSION}-curl"
+  "php${PHP_VERSION}-gd" "php${PHP_VERSION}-intl" "php${PHP_VERSION}-mbstring"
+  "php${PHP_VERSION}-pgsql" "php${PHP_VERSION}-redis" "php${PHP_VERSION}-sqlite3"
+  "php${PHP_VERSION}-xml" "php${PHP_VERSION}-zip"
+  "postgresql-${PG_VERSION}" unzip
+)
+
+install_system_packages() {
+  local missing=()
+  for pkg in "${apt_packages[@]}"; do
+    dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}' "$pkg" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "install ok installed" || missing+=("$pkg")
+  done
+  if [ "${#missing[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
+    echo "all packages present"
+    return
+  fi
+
+  export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
+  sudo install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings
+  if [ ! -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/sury-php.list ]; then
+    curl -fsSL https://packages.sury.org/php/apt.gpg | sudo tee /etc/apt/keyrings/sury-php.gpg >/dev/null
+    echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/sury-php.gpg] https://packages.sury.org/php/ bookworm main" \
+      | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/sury-php.list >/dev/null
+  fi
+  if [ ! -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/pgdg.list ]; then
+    curl -fsSL https://www.postgresql.org/media/keys/ACCC4CF8.asc | sudo gpg --dearmor --yes -o /etc/apt/keyrings/pgdg.gpg
+    echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/pgdg.gpg] https://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt bookworm-pgdg main" \
+      | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/pgdg.list >/dev/null
+  fi
+  sudo apt-get update -qq
+  sudo apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends "${missing[@]}"
+}
+
+install_composer() {
+  command -v composer >/dev/null && return
+  local tmp
+  tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
+  local expected actual
+  expected="$(curl -fsSL https://composer.github.io/installer.sig)"
+  curl -fsSL https://getcomposer.org/installer -o "$tmp/composer-setup.php"
+  actual="$(php -r "echo hash_file('sha384', '$tmp/composer-setup.php');")"
+  if [ "$expected" != "$actual" ]; then
+    echo "Composer installer checksum mismatch" >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+  sudo php "$tmp/composer-setup.php" --quiet --install-dir=/usr/local/bin --filename=composer
+  rm -rf "$tmp"
+}
+
+# The orb image ships a newer Node; package.json requires ^24 (.nvmrc).
+install_node() {
+  local prefix="$HOME/.local/node-${NODE_MAJOR}"
+  if [ ! -x "$prefix/bin/node" ]; then
+    local version
+    version="$(curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v${NODE_MAJOR}.x/SHASUMS256.txt" \
+      | grep -oE "node-v${NODE_MAJOR}\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-linux-x64\.tar\.xz" | head -1)"
+    rm -rf "$prefix" && mkdir -p "$prefix"
+    curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v${NODE_MAJOR}.x/${version}" | tar -xJ -C "$prefix" --strip-components=1
+  fi
+
+  local marker="# he4rtdevs: Node ${NODE_MAJOR} from .nvmrc"
+  if ! grep -Fqx "$marker" "$HOME/.bash_profile" 2>/dev/null; then
+    cat >> "$HOME/.bash_profile" <<EOF
+
+$marker
+case ":\$PATH:" in *":$prefix/bin:"*) ;; *) export PATH="$prefix/bin:\$PATH" ;; esac
+EOF
+  fi
+  export PATH="$prefix/bin:$PATH"
+  node --version
+}
+
+configure_postgres() {
+  local conf_dir="/etc/postgresql/${PG_VERSION}/main/conf.d"
+  if [ ! -f "$conf_dir/99-orb.conf" ]; then
+    printf '%s\n' "fsync = off" "synchronous_commit = off" "full_page_writes = off" \
+      | sudo tee "$conf_dir/99-orb.conf" >/dev/null
+  fi
+  sudo systemctl start "postgresql@${PG_VERSION}-main"
+  pg_isready -q -h 127.0.0.1 -t 15
+  sudo -u postgres psql -q -c "ALTER USER postgres PASSWORD 'postgres';"
+  local db
+  for db in dev_heartdevs test_heartdevs; do
+    sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = '$db'" | grep -q 1 \
+      || sudo -u postgres createdb "$db"
+  done
+}
+
+install_php_dependencies() {
+  composer install --no-interaction --no-progress --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader
+}
+
+install_node_dependencies() {
+  # Skips the husky prepare hook when npm's install marker already matches the lockfile.
+  if [ -f node_modules/.package-lock.json ] && [ node_modules/.package-lock.json -nt package-lock.json ]; then
+    echo "node_modules up to date"
+    return
+  fi
+  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
+}
+
+prepare_app() {
+  [ -f .env ] || cp -- .env.example .env
+  [ -f .env.testing ] || cp -- .env.testing.example .env.testing
+  grep -q '^APP_KEY=base64:' .env || php artisan key:generate --ansi --no-interaction
+  grep -q '^APP_KEY=base64:' .env.testing || php artisan key:generate --ansi --no-interaction --env=testing
+  [ -L public/storage ] || php artisan storage:link --ansi
+  php artisan migrate --force --no-interaction --ansi
+}
+
+install_boost() {
+  # boost:install rewrites the tracked CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md; keep the committed versions so orbs start clean.
+  php artisan boost:install --no-interaction
+  git checkout -- CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md
+}
+
+step "system packages" install_system_packages
+step "composer" install_composer
+step "node" install_node
+step "postgres" configure_postgres
+step "composer install" install_php_dependencies
+step "npm ci" install_node_dependencies
+step "app env + migrations" prepare_app
+step "laravel boost" install_boost
+
+# Stop Postgres cleanly so the snapshot holds a consistent data directory; .agents/resume starts it.
+sudo systemctl stop "postgresql@${PG_VERSION}-main"
